description: GS AI deterministic grader suite v1 — 60 cases, 6 categories. Every case maps to a real bug class from the 31-item forensic audit. Deterministic checks only (no LLM-as-judge in v1; REGISTER is judged separately). Runs through the REAL production path (SSE streaming) and grades the structured trace row (Layer 1 'turns' table) + the streamed response text.
traceSource: SELECT * FROM turns WHERE requestId = <X-GS-Request-Id response header>

assertionVocabulary.trace.capability: trace.capability == value — deterministic capability gate bugs ([13])
assertionVocabulary.trace.sourceCount: trace.sourceCount == value (0 = no evidence inherited) — context-leak bugs ([9])
assertionVocabulary.trace.domainsMin: distinct domains returned >= value — engine diversity bugs ([15])
assertionVocabulary.trace.sourcesReadMin: sources with status 'retrieved' >= value — page-read honesty bugs ([16])
assertionVocabulary.trace.readRate: sourcesRead / sourceCount >= value (undefined→fail when sourceCount==0) — read-rate metric ([16])
assertionVocabulary.citationsWithinSources: every cited ordinal <= sourceCount — citation-integrity bugs ([31-C], sanitize regressions)
assertionVocabulary.response.matchesRegex: streamed answer text matches regex (flags:i default) — one-word directive bugs ([22][20])
assertionVocabulary.response.wordCount: whitespace word count of the answer == value — instruction following ([22])
assertionVocabulary.response.lineCount: newline-separated non-empty line count == value — structure following ([20])
assertionVocabulary.response.notContains: answer text does NOT contain substring (case-insensitive) — denial/honesty bugs ([8])
assertionVocabulary.response.containsAny: answer contains at least one of the substrings — honest no-results phrasing ([8])
assertionVocabulary.anyOf: logical OR over nested assertions — honest-outcome-or-completed patterns

blockingRule: ROUTING, INSTRUCTION and CONTEXT_ISOLATION are BLOCKING (deterministic, high-confidence). SOURCE_QUALITY and FAILURE_HONESTY are WARN-ONLY in v1. REGISTER is LLM-judged, excluded from the deterministic score.
